title: 第23章 尽数灭杀第24章 四族全灭
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
说着，他一股强大的能量聚于他的手掌上。
目光冰冷的扫视着四周。
而当他的目光落到李天行一众李家族人身上的时候。
他们顿时打了个冷颤，强大的压迫感让他们感到了莫名的压抑。
天阴老人眼神阴狠，他手掌中的那道强大能量，轰然朝着李天行所在轰击而去。
并伴随着一个死字！
“死！”
如此威能之下，李天行只觉压力山大，想要逃遁却又发现那道极为阴冷的能量已经把他给锁定住了！
就在众人以为李家众人要被那道强大能量给轰灭了的时候。
突然，周围虚空像是被按了暂停键一样！
只见那道朝李天行等人轰击强大能量竟一动不动地悬停在半空中。
再也不能前进半点！
紧接着，一位青衣老者凭空出现在了众人面前。
挥手间，天阴老人的那道强大能量却在被他轻易化去！
来人正是李家老祖李北玄，他目光不善地看向对方六人。
最后才将目光定格在天阴老人身上！
“是你们在找我？还要杀我族人？”
李北玄的极为冷冽，且不带丝毫感情。
对于现在的李北玄来说，他最不能容忍的便是有人要对他的族人出手。
想要断我崛起的根基，就看你能否承受得起这个代价！

天阴老人闻言，连忙看向来人。
一看之下，他的心头莫名一颤，对方轻易化解了他的攻击不说，自己竟还看不出对方的深浅。
而且他还感受到一股莫名的杀意！
四大家族的老祖也都震惊看向突然现身的李北玄。
其中的王家老祖，也都从这个突然现身之人身上感到了巨大压力。
而李天行等李家族人，随着李北玄出现之后，身上的压力也随之消失。
再次感受到了久违的轻松。
天阴老人看着李北玄冷哼一声，“哼，李老鬼，你莫要在这里虚张声势，你终于舍得出来了！
今日便让我将你我的恩怨给一并了结了吧！”
语气之阴冷，气势飞扬，声音之中还带着冷冽的杀意。
虽然他看不出对方的深浅，但是他也不认为李北玄会突破境界。
所以他又何惧之有！
然而，随着他的话音落下，李北玄冷冷了说了一句。
“聒噪！”
content_en:
As he spoke, a powerful energy gathered in his palm.
He glanced around with cold eyes.
And when his eyes fell on Li Tianxing and other members of the Li family.
They shuddered immediately, and the strong sense of oppression made them feel inexplicably depressed.
Old Man Tianyin's eyes were sinister, and the powerful energy in his palm suddenly bombarded towards where Li Tianxing was.
And accompanied by the word death!
"Death!"
Under such power, Li Tianxing felt great pressure. He wanted to escape but found that the extremely cold energy had locked him!
Just when everyone thought that everyone in the Li family was going to be destroyed by that powerful energy.
Suddenly, the surrounding void seemed to have been pressed on the pause button!
I saw that the powerful energy that was bombarding Li Tianxing and others was hovering motionless in mid-air.
Can't make any further progress!
Immediately afterwards, an old man in green appeared in front of everyone out of thin air.
As he waved his hand, Old Man Tianyin's powerful energy was easily dispelled by him!
The person who came was none other than Li Beixuan, the ancestor of the Li family. He looked at the six other people with unkind eyes.
Finally, he fixed his gaze on Old Man Tianyin!
"Are you looking for me? Are you going to kill my people?"
Li Beixuan was extremely cold and emotionless.
For Li Beixuan now, what he can't tolerate the most is someone trying to take action against his tribe.
If you want to cut off the foundation of my rise, it depends on whether you can afford the price!
When old man Tianyin heard this, he quickly looked at the person coming.
At first glance, his heart trembled inexplicably. Not only did the other party easily neutralize his attack, he actually couldn't see the depth of the other party.
And he also felt an inexplicable killing intent!
The ancestors of the four major families also looked at Li Beixuan who suddenly appeared in shock.
Among them, the ancestors of the Wang family also felt tremendous pressure from this sudden appearance.
As for Li Tianxing and other Li family members, with the appearance of Li Beixuan, the pressure on them also disappeared.
I felt the long-lost relaxation again.
Old Man Tianyin looked at Li Beixuan and snorted coldly, "Huh, Old Ghost Li, don't try to bluff here, you are finally willing to give it up!
Let me settle our grudges today! "
The tone was cold, the momentum was high, and there was a cold murderous intent in the voice.
Although he couldn't see the depth of the opponent, he didn't think Li Beixuan would break through.
So what should he fear?
However, as his words fell, Li Beixuan said coldly.
"Noisy!"
